E0969

An `imports:` discovery directive isn't `find("<dir>")` with a single literal path.

What

An `imports:` discovery directive isn't `find("<dir>")` with a single literal path.

Why

Imports auto-discover a directory of modules (U4); discovery uses one literal `find` path, while recognized first-party integrations use their typed calls.

Fix

Write `imports: find("./modules")`, or use a recognized typed integration call.
